title: A 5 step method to find your Meta Ad Hook Success Rate
description: A 5 step method to find your Meta Ad Hook Success Rate
transcript: How to analyze your meta ad hooks here's a five step process. Step 1 go to Ads Manager and click Columns. Step 2 select customize Columns. Step 3 scroll down and create a custom metric. Step 4 name it hook rate step 5 set the formula your hook rate is 3 second video views divided by impressions. Then hit save and it can show up alongside any video ad you have in your ad account.
